title: Vizmatic
description: A vector animation engine and diagram library for TypeScript. Films play live in the browser, seek instantly, and export to exact MP4.

title: Films
description: Short mathematical and technical films made with Vizmatic. Each one plays live in your browser, with its full source.

title: Examples
description: Rendered diagrams, charts, dashboards, and lessons with their editable TSX source, in dark and light.

title: Components
description: Choose a Vizmatic component and see it render. Explore live examples, change visual settings, edit the TSX, and download the result.

title: Diagram builder
description: Build diagrams and charts on an editable canvas. Arrange components, edit data, route connectors, save projects, and export PNG, SVG, or GIF.

title: For agents
description: Install the Vizmatic skill, use a verified render workflow, and discover machine-readable instructions and runnable component examples.

title: Benchmarks
description: Inspect reproducible Vizmatic render time, process memory, environment details, and automated example-check results.

title: Studio
description: Build and animate films in one browser tab: a timeline, an inspector, live code, and frame-exact MP4 export.

title: Vizmatic
description: Lit curves gather into the wordmark and let go again, as a seamless ten-second loop.

title: A drawing is a sum of circles
description: A real Fourier transform of an ampersand, redrawn by a chain of rotating arrows as the term count grows from 1 to 200.

title: A matrix moves the whole plane
description: A grid under one matrix: basis arrows, the determinant as area, and the two directions that stay on their lines.

title: The grid bends, its right angles survive
description: A grid unfolds under z squared and curls into a disk under a Mobius map, with the angle at every crossing measured live.

title: One point, two shadows
description: A point sweeps the unit circle, sine and cosine trace themselves, and the formula collapses into Euler's identity.

title: Downhill, one step at a time
description: Real gradient descent on a two-basin loss surface: two starts 0.12 apart travel together, then finish in different minima.

title: Attention, computed
description: Queries, keys, and values produce a live heatmap as softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d)) V builds up term by term.

title: The rules are exact, the future is not
description: The Lorenz system integrated with real numbers: two starts a hair apart part ways, then 72 fill the butterfly.

title: Twelve coin flips, nine hundred times
description: A Galton board settles into a histogram that meets the Gaussian curve, with mean and deviation measured from the balls.

title: Move the pieces, keep the square
description: A proof by rearrangement: four triangles slide inside a square, and the leftover area writes the theorem.

title: Sine, from what it does at zero
description: Polynomials hug the sine curve further out as each term grows in, with the trusted range measured live.

title: One key expires
description: A dense service diagram comes alive: a hot key expires at 12,000 requests per second, and a simulated stampede hits Postgres.

title: Why we rebuilt the renderer
description: A six-chapter talk that plays in stepped mode, with a live timeline and measured results.

title: Getting started
description: Write a film as a TypeScript function, watch it in your browser, and export it to MP4. This takes about two minutes.

title: Core concepts
description: A film is a function that writes keys on a timeline. Any frame can then be sampled at any time, in any order.

title: Animations
description: Every animation in the library, each with a small live demo. Pass any of these to s.play.

title: moveTo, shift, scaleBy, rotate, recolor, fade
Text and math
description: Text and equations are real vector glyphs. Handwrite them, stagger them, or morph one equation into another, term by term.

title: Camera
description: The camera is a node. Move it, zoom it, or turn it with the same animations as anything else.

title: 3D
description: A 3D scene is a node. It projects meshes, curves, and points to vector paths on every frame, so a browser and an export draw the same picture.

title: Objects
description: Ready-made math, chart, and computer science objects. Each one is a node, so every animation works on it.

title: Looks and color
description: A look is a complete art direction. Write color names in your film, and render the same source in any look.

title: Diagrams and density
description: The TSX component library draws static figures. It packs a page of facts into a frame by default, and it renders larger when you are presenting.

title: Figures reference
description: Render TSX figures to PNG, SVG, and GIF. This page covers the frame format, render options, themes, primitives, and the programmatic API.

title: Figure recipes
description: The component API by prop, with complete frames for common figures. Copy one and change the content.

title: Presentations
description: A film with chapters is a talk. In stepped mode, the player stops at each chapter and waits for your key press.

title: Exporting
description: Export MP4, WebM, GIF, PNG, and SVG from the command line or from code. Frames rasterize on worker threads and encode in order.

title: Embedding the player
description: Drop a live, seekable film into any page with one element. It is crisp at any zoom and loads when it scrolls near.

title: CLI
description: Create, preview, check, and export films, and render static figures, from the command line.

title: For agents
description: Vizmatic suits coding agents. Sources are plain text, output is deterministic, and problems come back as JSON.

title: Why the source suits an agent
Cookbook
description: Short recipes for things people often want. Each one is a complete film you can copy.

title: A point that follows a curve
API reference
description: Every public export, generated from the TypeScript source when the site builds.

title: CompiledFilm
description: A film ready to sample. frame(t) is pure: seek to any time, in any order.

title: compileFilm
description: Run the build function, waiting for fonts and math when it asks for them, and return a seekable film.

title: film
description: Define a film: a function that authors a timeline on a stage.

title: isSuspend
description: True for a Suspend thrown by any copy of the engine.

title: Stage
description: The timeline a film is authored on. All coordinates are centered: (0, 0) is mid-frame and y points down.

title: Suspend
description: Thrown while an asset loads. The compiler waits and runs the build function again.

title: along
description: Follow a path, or the shape of a node, from start to end.

title: Anim
description: A piece of motion. schedule writes timeline keys for a window of time.

title: appear
description: Show at this moment, with no transition.

title: applyMatrix
description: Multiply a node's geometry by a 2x2 matrix around a stage point.

title: call
description: Run a plain function at a moment on the timeline.

title: circumscribe
description: Trace a line around a node for emphasis, then let it run off.

title: draw
description: Trace strokes in order. Filled shapes outline first, then fill.

title: flash
description: Radial burst at a point, for a moment of arrival.

title: grow
description: Scale up from nothing. Pass a stage point to grow from it, such as an arrow's tail.

title: indicate
description: Swell and tint for a moment, then return.

title: lagged
description: Start each piece after a fraction of the previous one has played.

title: morph
description: Turn from into to, whatever their shapes. Afterwards to is on stage and from is hidden, so later code always refers to the node it can see.

title: morphMatching
description: Morph equations and labels by meaning. Glyphs that exist on both sides travel to their new places. The rest fade out or in where they stand.

title: par
description: Run together. Each piece keeps its own length unless the whole is rescaled.

title: pulse
description: A short lit segment that travels along a line: a packet on an edge, a signal on a wire. The source line stays in place underneath.

title: retime
description: Change an animation's length or easing without changing what it does.

title: ripple
description: Expanding ring that fades out, for a pulse from a point.

title: shake
description: Shake gently to draw the eye.

title: to
description: Animate any change. Make the change on the node inside the callback, and the engine interpolates from the old state to the new one, including geometry. s.play(to(dot, (d) => d.moveTo(axes.p(2, 4)).color('yellow').scale(1.5)))

title: Value
description: A number on the timeline. Read .value inside dynamic and update to drive anything.

title: vanish
description: Hide at this moment, with no transition.

title: warp
description: Deform every shape under a node through a function of stage position. This is how a grid bends under a matrix or a complex map.

title: write
description: Handwrite text and equations: each glyph is outlined, then filled.

title: dynamic
description: A node that rebuilds its contents on every frame from timeline values.

title: group
description: A group. Children keep their own transforms inside it.

title: Node
description: Every visible thing on stage. A node with a path draws. A node with children groups. Both can carry a transform, and every property can change over time. Setter methods chain and apply at the current point on the timeline, so the same calls set up a node before it appears and change it afterwards.

title: arrow
description: A shaft and a clean tip as one group. The shaft ends at the tip's base, so a thick line never pokes through the point.

title: brace
description: Curly brace beside a span of two points, pointing out to one side.

title: curve
description: A smooth curve through points. Non-finite points leave gaps.

title: shape
description: Wrap any path as a stroked shape in the default ink.

title: angleMark
description: An angle at a vertex, between the rays toward two points.

title: applyComplex
description: Deform a complex plane through f(re, im). Labels stay readable by fading separately, so this moves only the grid.

title: areaUnder
description: Shaded region between a curve and the x axis. Pass functions for bounds that move.

title: ArrayCells
description: A row of boxes. swap(i, j) lifts two items over each other, and .cell(i) follows them.

title: attentionMatrix
description: Attention weights as a heatmap, with source tokens across the top and targets down the side. It is a Heatmap, so .cell(i, j) and .row(i) work.

title: Axes
description: Coordinate axes. .p(x, y) converts math coordinates to stage points in this group's local space, and .plot(f) draws a function on them.

title: BarChart
description: Bars with direct labels and a single hairline baseline. enter() grows them from zero and update(values) animates to new data, with readouts that count.

title: braceLabel
description: A brace along one side of a node or nodes, with a label at its point.

title: Callout
description: A note with a leader line back to what it describes. The leader stops at the text block's edge, so it never runs through the words.

title: checkFilm
description: Inspect a film for layout defects: marks off the canvas, text on text, and strokes through text. It looks where the film comes to rest, because objects may cross each other while moving. Runs anywhere, with no rendering.

title: CodeBlock
description: Syntax-colored code as real glyphs. It can be written on, focused line by line, and morphed token by token into a new version with morphCode.

title: complex
description: Small complex arithmetic on [re, im] pairs.

title: Connector
description: A line between two nodes that is routed fresh on every frame. Move a node and the line follows. draw(connector) traces it, and .pulse() sends a signal.

title: Counter
description: A number readout. Animate it with countUp.

title: countUp
description: Count a Counter or Value to a target.

title: dashedGuides
description: Dashed drop lines from a point on the axes. Pass functions to follow a moving point.

title: decimal
description: A number readout that follows a function of the timeline, drawn fresh each frame.

title: Epicycles
description: Circles on circles: the tip of the chain draws the original shape.

title: fourier
description: Discrete Fourier transform of a closed outline, largest terms first. Sample the points evenly along the outline, for example with samplePath.

title: fourierPoint
description: Value of a Fourier series at u, where u from 0 to 1 is one trip around the shape.

title: fromComponent
description: Render any Vizmatic TSX component and return it as animatable vector nodes, so every existing diagram and chart can be written on, faded, and morphed. It runs in Node only, because it needs the layout engine: const flow = await fromComponent(<Flow c={c} stages={stages} />, { width: 900, height: 300 }) s.play(write(flow))

title: fromSvg
description: Turn SVG markup into stage nodes. Each shape becomes a leaf whose origin is its center, so it can be drawn, faded, scaled, and morphed like anything else. Filters and masks are skipped, because shapes draw without them.

title: Graph
description: Nodes and edges with a stable layout. node(id) and edge(from, to) return ordinary nodes, so every verb works on them, and visit and pulseEdge tell an algorithm's story.

title: highlightSweep
description: A marker stroke sweeps across a target and stays behind it. .mark is the node, so it can be faded out later.

title: Histogram
description: A distribution that can fill up over time. fillUp() drops the samples in, in order, so bars rise exactly as the data accumulates.

title: InfoBox
description: A compact node for system stories: a title, a status, and rows of labeled metrics at reading size. It packs information like an engineering figure, not a slide. For a talk, raise size and the whole box scales with it.

title: LabeledDot
description: A point with a label. The node's origin stays on the point.

title: legend
description: A small key. Prefer direct labels. Use this when a figure holds too many marks to label.

title: MatrixNode
description: A typeset matrix with real TeX brackets. Each entry is its own node.

title: morphCode
description: Morph one version of code into another. Tokens are matched in order, so unchanged code slides to its new place and only real edits fade.

title: NeuralNet
description: Layers of neurons joined by hairline weights. forward() runs a signal through it.

title: NumberPlane
description: The classic infinite grid. Each line is a dense path, so it bends smoothly under applyMatrix and under warp with a nonlinear function.

title: PieChart
description: Share of a whole, labeled directly. enter() sweeps around, and update() re-divides it.

title: riemann
description: Rectangles under a curve. Morph one set into a finer one to show the integral appear.

title: rightAngle
description: The small square that marks a right angle.

title: ringThrough
description: A closed outline shrunk to a parametric function.

title: samplePath
description: Evenly spaced points along a path, by arc length.

title: secantLine
description: The line through two points on a curve. Pass functions to shrink h on screen.

title: setAssetBase
description: Tell the browser build where fonts live. The URL must end with a slash.

title: sparkline
description: A word-sized line chart, with no axes.

title: spin
description: Steady rotation for as long as it plays: radians per second, around the center or a point.

title: StreamLines
description: Flow made visible: lines are integrated once, then light runs along them. Drawing is batched by color and brightness, so hundreds of lines stay live.

title: surroundingBox
description: A rounded box around a node or nodes, measured now.

title: SvgNode
description: An imported picture. It is a regular node tree, so every verb works on it.

title: swap
description: Two nodes trade places along opposite arcs.

title: tangentLine
description: The tangent at x, as a line on the axes. Pass a function of time to make it slide.

title: tokenize
description: A small tokenizer for film code. It colors the common cases and never blocks on odd input.

title: TokenRow
description: A sequence of token chips, as in a tokenizer's output. Small type by default.

title: traced
description: The path a moving point has taken. It is computed by re-reading the point at earlier times, so it scrubs correctly in both directions. The point function should read Values or tracked node properties, not update overlays.

title: TreeGraph
description: A tidy tree: parents center over children, and subtrees never overlap.

title: typewriter
description: Characters appear one at a time, at a steady rate, with an optional cursor.

title: VectorField
description: A grid of arrows that shows a field's direction and strength. y points up in field space.

title: wipe
description: Reveal marks in the order a moving edge reaches them. Each mark fades up as the edge passes, so a dense diagram opens like a sweep across the page.

title: Axes3D
description: Three axes with ticks and tips.

title: Curve3D
description: A curve in space, cut into pieces so it passes correctly in front of and behind other marks.

title: GridPlane3D
description: A hairline grid on a horizontal plane, to ground a scene.

title: Label3D
description: A label pinned to a point in space. It always faces the camera.

title: Line3D
description: A straight line in space. Ends can be functions, so it can follow moving points.

title: Object3D
description: A thing in a 3D scene. It is a regular node with an empty 2D path, so verbs work on it: fadeIn sets opacity, and draw animates its reveal through trimTo.

title: parametricSurface
description: A surface over any two parameters.

title: point3d
description: One point in space, as a convenience over points3d.

title: Points3D
description: Points in space. Pass a function to move them. They shrink with distance and sort with everything else.

title: surface
description: A height field z = f(x, y). f also receives time when animate is on.

title: Surface3D
description: A shaded mesh. Faces sort with everything else in the scene, so objects can intersect.

title: Trail3D
description: The path a moving point has taken, with a fading tail. Scrubs correctly in both directions.

title: Vector3D
description: An arrow in space. The head always faces the camera, so it reads from any angle.

title: View3D
description: Everything an object needs to project itself for one frame.

title: fontFor
description: Get a font now, or suspend the current compile until it arrives.

title: glyphPath
description: Glyph outline scaled to a pixel size, with y pointing down and the origin on the baseline.

title: tex
description: Typeset TeX with real math glyphs. tex.part('x^2') selects a term for color or morphing.

title: TexNode
description: Typeset equation as glyph nodes. Ordinary characters keep their identity for morphs.

title: TextNode
description: A line or block of text as real vector glyphs. Each glyph is its own child, so text can be handwritten, staggered, or morphed. .chars lists them in order.

title: during
description: Restrict an ease to a window of the animation.

title: Ease
description: Rate functions map animation progress in [0, 1] to eased progress.

title: lingering
description: Holds at 1 for the last part of the time.

title: notQuiteThere
description: Stops short of the target, for an unfinished gesture.

title: overshoot
description: Overshoot the target once, then settle.

title: runningStart
description: Backs up briefly, then runs through to the target.

title: smoothBy
description: The house default. A sigmoid with a calm start and a calm landing.

title: smoother
description: Fifth-order smoothstep, for long camera moves.

title: spring
description: Physically based settle. Exactly 1 at t=1 so holds never drift.

title: thereAndBack
description: Goes to 1 and returns to 0. Ends where it started, for emphasis.

title: blueprint
description: Drafting-table navy with cool cyan linework.

title: chalk
description: Near-black green with warm chalk, for classroom-style lessons.

title: colorAlong
description: Color that travels along a stroke, such as a graph that warms from left to right.

title: Look
description: A look is a complete art direction for a film: background, ink, a small set of named pigments, and how much light the image gives off. Authors write color: 'yellow', so one film renders correctly in every look.

title: midnight
description: Deep neutral black with luminous pigments. The default.

title: mixColor
description: Mix two colors in OKLab, which keeps blends bright and even in tone.

title: neon
description: Saturated light on pure black, for trailers and hero loops.

title: paper
description: Warm paper and printed ink, for articles and print.

title: ramp
description: Evenly spaced colors between stops, for coloring a list of items.

title: Rgba
description: r, g, b from 0 to 255 and alpha from 0 to 1.

title: arcPath
description: Elliptical or circular arc, with one cubic per 45 degrees at most.

title: curveThrough
description: Hermite fit through samples. Non-finite samples split the curve into separate rings, so poles such as tan(x) leave gaps instead of drawing vertical strokes.

title: Mat
description: 2x3 affine matrix: x' = a*x + c*y + e, y' = b*x + d*y + f.

title: matScale
description: Mean scale of a matrix, used to scale stroke widths with the geometry.

title: parametricPath
description: Smooth open curve through samples of a parametric function.

title: parseSvgPath
description: Parse SVG path data, including arcs and relative commands, into cubic rings.

title: pathToD
description: Serialize a path to compact SVG path data.

title: pointAt
description: Point at an arc-length fraction of a path, in the path's own coordinates.

title: signedArea
description: Shoelace area over the anchors. The sign gives the winding direction.

title: smoothPath
description: A smooth cubic spline through every point (Catmull-Rom, centripetal-ish tension).

title: subdivideEach
description: Split every segment of a ring into n equal parameter pieces. Geometry is unchanged.

title: tangentAt
description: Unit tangent at an arc-length fraction, in the path's own coordinates.

title: trimPath
description: Keep a fraction of a path. With each, every ring draws at once, which suits glyphs. Without it, rings draw one after another along the total length.

title: trimRing
description: Keep the part of a ring between two arc-length fractions.

title: Vec
description: Vector geometry for the stage engine. Every shape is a list of rings. A ring is a run of cubic Bezier segments in a flat array: [x0, y0, c1x, c1y, c2x, c2y, x1, y1, c1x, ...]. One representation for lines, arcs, glyphs, and imported SVG makes any shape morph into any other. Rings and paths are immutable by convention. Length tables and bounds are cached per ring, so sampling the same geometry on many frames stays cheap.

title: warpPath
description: Deform a path through any point function. Segments split first, so curved maps stay smooth.

title: frameInkBounds
description: Pixel-space bounds of a frame's ink, used by checks for off-canvas marks.

title: frameToSvg
description: Serialize a frame to standalone SVG. Text is already outlines, so no fonts are needed.

title: paintFrame
description: Paint a frame to a 2D context at a device scale. Same result as the SVG backend.

title: Editable scenes
description: Run editable TSX from users or agents in a bounded sandbox, and render it to PNG or MP4 in an application.

title: TSX animation and MP4
description: Animate TSX figures with typed state timelines, and export them to GIF and MP4. For new motion work, use films.

title: Sparkline
description: A word-sized trend line to set beside a number.

title: SmallMultiples
description: One chart repeated across services or regions, with an optional shared scale.

title: MetricStrip
description: Numbers with units side by side, without a card around each one.

title: FactRows
description: Tight key and value rows with optional capacity bars.

title: InlineBar
description: A hairline capacity bar that sits under a value.

title: StatusDot
description: A small health marker: ok, warn, error, idle, or any tone.

title: TagList
description: Small hairline tags for runtime, region, tier, or owner.

title: DiagramLegend
description: A one-line key with line samples and swatches.

title: PixelGrid
description: Byte-accurate RGB image and channel planes with square pixels, crop outlines, and active-cell focus.

title: Canvas
description: Root canvas with transparent or custom backgrounds and padding.

title: Board
description: Fixed-size canvas for freely positioned visuals in one coordinate space.

title: CanvasItem
description: Positions and sizes a visual relative to its parent Board.

title: Scene
description: Primary vertical scene layout with optional title and subtitle.

title: Row
description: Horizontal flex layout with stable gaps and alignment.

title: Column
description: Vertical flex layout for stacked composition.

title: Stack
description: Compact vertical grouping for related content.

title: Panel
description: Titled container for grouped visual content.

title: Card
description: General-purpose surface with tone, padding, and shadow.

title: MathText
description: Math-aware text formatting for React content.

title: SvgMathText
description: Positioned math overlay aligned with custom SVG geometry.

title: BadgePill
description: Inline status, category, or metadata label.

title: MetricCard
description: KPI value with label and context.

title: CodeBlock
description: Code or command excerpt with optional line numbers.

title: Tile
description: Single labeled unit for feature or system maps.

title: TileGrid
description: Dense grid of related labeled units.

title: Watermark
description: Frame metadata for text, image, or custom branding.

title: StatusList
description: Grouped checks, warnings, and pending work.

title: Timeline
description: Ordered events in horizontal or vertical form.

title: Pipeline
description: Compact process pipeline with shared title.

title: LayeredNetwork
description: Layered neural network or staged DAG.

title: GraphDiagram
description: Auto-laid architecture graph with nested groups, icons, and semantic edges.

title: TreeDiagram
description: Auto-laid hierarchy, taxonomy, or decision tree.

title: SequenceDiagram
description: Typed participants, messages, notes, activations, and alt, loop, or parallel fragments.

title: DataflowDiagram
description: Schema-aware batch and streaming lineage compiled into a stable directed graph.

title: DeploymentDiagram
description: Nested region, network, and runtime boundaries with typed network connections.

title: TransformerTopology
description: Transformer computation topology with tensor metadata and collective routes.

title: Matrix
description: Numeric or symbolic matrix with headers.

title: Heatmap
description: Color-scaled matrix for intensity and correlation.

title: TiledMatrix
description: Matrix with named regions and boundaries.

title: DataTable
description: Structured rows and columns with headers.

title: MiniBarChart
description: Compact categorical bars for dense layouts.

title: ChartFrame
description: Shared chart title, subtitle, legend, and footer.

title: PieChart
description: Part-to-whole composition with a full circular radius.

title: BarChart
description: Categorical comparison with labels and values.

title: LineChart
description: One or more trends across an ordered axis.

title: ScatterPlot
description: Point distribution across two numeric axes.

title: ParetoBarChart
description: Descending category counts with a cumulative percentage line.

title: ParetoChart
description: Automatic non-dominated frontier across competing numeric objectives.

title: QuadrantChart
description: Numeric decision map split by configurable policy thresholds.

title: IntervalPlot
description: Low, midpoint, and high ranges by category.

title: Legend
description: Reusable color key for charts and diagrams.

title: NumberLine
description: Signed intervals, labeled values, and markers on a numeric line.

title: GeometryDiagram
description: Labeled points, measured segments, and angle constructions.

title: FreeBodyDiagram
description: Forces, components, and the resultant acting on one body.

title: WaveDiagram
description: Component waves and their superposition across position and time.

title: MoleculeDiagram
description: Element-labeled atoms, bond orders, charges, and isotopes.

title: ReactionEquation
description: Reactants and products with coefficients, states, and conditions.

title: ReactionEnergyDiagram
description: Reactant and product energy with activation barriers.

title: AttentionMatrix
description: Probability-normalized attention with causal masks and focus highlights.

title: Box
description: Rounded SVG box with label and tone.

title: FlowArrow
description: Straight directional connector with label and tone.

title: Connector
description: Alias for flow connectors in diagram code.

title: VectorArrow
description: Vector with optional endpoints and arrowhead.

title: SvgFrame
description: SVG plotting frame with border and fill.

title: DotPoint
description: Point marker with optional text label.

title: DashedLine
description: Dotted or dashed SVG guide line.

title: AxisPlot
description: Coordinate plane for points, vectors, and paths.
